description: This file defines the MetadataEnvelope class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling encryption metadata in cryptographic operations. It includes constants for various header fields, methods for managing these headers, and implements interfaces for array access, iteration, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MetadataEnvelope
classes.description: A class that encapsulates encryption metadata, providing methods to manage cryptographic headers and conforming to PHP interfaces for array access, iteration, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getConstantValues
methods.description: Returns all recognized constant header names used within the envelope.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a header value if the header name matches a predefined constant; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the envelope data to JSON format.
